review.evidence: docs/hanzifun-rebuild/acceptance/phase-2-hf12-language-review.md; Owner explicitly accepted all 15 sentences and physical-device checks in the 2026-10-27 Phase 2 closeout instruction.
review.scope: All three scenarios: Chinese, pinyin, English translations, token meanings and context, plus physical-device acceptance.

scenarios.title: Airport transport in Chinese
scenarios.context: Ask about a flight arrival, find a taxi and check a fare. Use these Mandarin phrases when speaking with Chinese-speaking staff or fellow travellers.

sentences.translation: What time does the plane arrive?
Excuse me, where are the taxis?
tokens: where; 儿 joins the preceding syllable

sentences.translation: I would like to go into town.
How much is it to get to the hotel?
tokens: hotel here; can also mean restaurant

scenarios.title: Hotel check-in in Chinese
scenarios.context: Ask for a room, confirm the length of the stay and ask about breakfast. 饭店 means hotel in this setting; confirm the destination with your host.

sentences.pinyin: Nín hǎo, wǒ yào yí ge fángjiān.
sentences.translation: Hello, I would like a room.
I would like to stay for two days.
tokens: two days; confirm the checkout date separately

scenarios.title: Supermarket shopping in Chinese
scenarios.context: Find a supermarket, ask for everyday groceries and compare prices. Prices depend on the shop and package; these sentences make no claims about ingredients or food safety.

tokens: where; 儿 joins the preceding syllable

sentences.translation: I would like to buy milk.
Do you have a cheaper one?
